variant_desc: 1M-key chained hash set distinct-count (O(N) memory, ~16MB malloc churn) -> HLL with 16384 6-bit registers (12 KB fixed) harmonic-mean estimate (variant 4: seed=46, n_scale=0.7x)
source_citation: Redis hyperloglog.c source (antirez) + antirez 2014 blog 'Stream algorithms and HyperLogLog' http://antirez.com/news/75
novelty_rationale: Tests algorithmic recognition that exact distinct-count can be swapped for an approximate sketch with bounded error when the user only needs a cardinality estimate (Redis HLL ships at ~0.81% theoretical error with a fixed 12 KB footprint regardless of N). No compiler converts an exact hash-set distinct-count into a HyperLogLog because the swap changes observable output (exact -> approximate); requires reasoning about acceptable error bounds rather than per-loop micro-optimization.
